entries.source: - special skeleton talents: bone armour, resilient bones, re-assemble
entries.target: - 特殊骷髅技能：骨质盔甲、弹力骨骼、重组

entries.source: One race, one mind, one way. Our oppression shall end, and we shall inherit Eyal. Do not presume we are weak - our way is true, and only those who help us shall see our strength.
entries.target: 一个种族，一种思想，一种道路。我们的压迫终将结束，而我们将继承埃亚尔。不要以为我们软弱——我们的道路才是真理，只有帮助我们的人才能见识到我们的力量。

entries.source: Yeeks are a mysterious race of small humanoids native to the tropical island of Rel.
entries.target: 夺心魔是一支神秘的矮小人形种族，生活于热带岛屿瑞尔。

entries.source: Their body is covered with white fur and their disproportionate heads give them a ridiculous look.
entries.target: 他们的身体覆盖着白色毛发，不成比例的头颅让他们看上去滑稽可笑。

entries.source: Although they are now nearly unheard of in Maj'Eyal, they spent many thousand years as secret slaves to the Halfling nation of Nargol.
entries.target: 尽管如今在马基·埃亚尔几乎无人知晓他们，但他们曾作为纳格尔半身人王国的秘密奴隶度过数千年。

entries.source: They gained their freedom during the Age of Pyre and have since then followed 'The Way' - a unity of minds enforced by their powerful psionics.
entries.target: 他们在烈火纪获得了自由，此后一直遵循“维网”——一个由他们强大的灵能维系的心智统一体。
